description: The chart illustrates the task count for various language families across three categories: "better", "XLM-R", and "same", with the data represented using grouped bars. The horizontal axis lists nine language families, namely IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic, in a fixed order. The vertical axis is labeled "task count" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 40, with tick labels at intervals of 10. Each language family is associated with three bars, colored light blue, dark blue, and green, representing "mBERT", "XLM-R", and "same", respectively. The bar heights vary across language families and categories, with the tallest bar reaching approximately 38 for "IE-Slavic" in the "XLM-R" category, and the shortest bars being around 1 for several language families in the "better" category. The bars are grouped by language family, with the three categories presented together for each family. The chart does not display any specific sorting order for the bars beyond the fixed order of language families on the horizontal axis, and no bars are visually emphasized.
